arStrings.szText: Prava and her wretched Knights found our hidden chapel and drove us from the glacier. We were outnumbered and had no choice but to flee. We subsisted for a time on wild creatures, but such sickly rations could not hold us long.
We embarked for Skovos under the cover of night. The sea grows violent, and the voyage longer than expected. I feel weak for want of blood. Soon we must feed again.
